rubric.role_summary: Founding commercial leader for an AI operating system serving real estate agencies in Spain. Build the go-to-market engine from zero, close initial agency accounts, develop a repeatable sales process, and eventually lead the commercial team.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Founding commercial leader for an AI operating system serving real estate agencies in Spain. Build the go-to-market engine from zero, close initial agency accounts, develop a repeatable sales process, and eventually lead the commercial team.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Has carried a sales quota and personally closed deals.
- Has zero-to-one experience in an early-stage environment, or has built a territory, vertical, or channel from nothing in a fast-paced company.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Sales experience with SMBs or traditional, relationship-driven sectors in Spain, such as real estate, insurance, or professional services.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Barcelona, Spain area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
